title: Global Smartphone Shipments and Vendor Share, 2025

sheets.name: IDC Vendor Data
sheets.title: Global smartphone shipments by vendor, full-year 2025 (IDC, preliminary)
notes: Unit: million units; period: calendar year 2025 vs 2024; IDC Worldwide Quarterly Mobile Phone Tracker, preliminary data dated 13 Jan 2026 [1].
IDC total: 1,260.3M units in 2025 and 1,236.3M in 2024 (+1.9%) [1]. The Android Headlines article repeats the same IDC figures, so it counts as one source.

sheets.name: Cross-check
sheets.title: Cross-check of 2025 figures across research firms
notes: Blank cells mean the firm's public release did not give that figure in the pages read; they are not zero.
Omdia reports Apple (iPhone) 240.6M, vivo 105.3M and OPPO 100.7M; its Samsung and Xiaomi unit figures were not stated [2]. Omdia total: about 1.25 billion units, +2% [2].
Counterpoint shares are rounded to whole percent; total 1,255 million units, +3% on its own page [4], while Reuters coverage of the January release says +2% [3].
Firms differ in method: Apple is 247.8M (IDC) vs 240.6M (Omdia).

sheets.name: Summary
rows: Global smartphone shipments by vendor, calendar year 2025 (latest full year as of Nov 2026). Main dataset: IDC preliminary data; cross-checked against Omdia and Counterpoint.
Apple was the largest vendor in 2025 with 247.8M units and 19.7% share (IDC), ahead of Samsung at 241.2M and 19.1% [1]. Omdia and Counterpoint also rank Apple first [2][3].
Xiaomi was third with 165.3M units and 13.1% share, down 1.9% year on year; vivo (103.9M) and OPPO (102.0M) followed [1].
The top five vendors together held about 68% of shipments; the rest of the market was 31.7% [1].
The market grew about 2% in 2025 to roughly 1.25 to 1.26 billion units [1][2][3].
IDC data is preliminary. Totals differ by firm: IDC 1,260.3M, Omdia about 1,250M, Counterpoint 1,255M [1][2][4].

Apple, Samsung and Xiaomi shares in the cross-check come from three firms using different methods; the vendor-level split is single-source (IDC) for vivo, OPPO and Others in the data sheet, with Omdia unit figures as a partial check [2].
